description: Donut chart showing the share of total visitor trips to Australia by world region (2024). Asia-Pacific dominates with over two-thirds of all visits. Data source: Tourism Research Australia, IVS 2024.

transform.calculate: indexof(['New Zealand'], datum.country) >= 0 ? 'Pacific' : indexof(['Japan','Hong Kong','Singapore','Malaysia','Indonesia','Taiwan','Thailand','Vietnam','Philippines','South Korea','China','India','Other Asia'], datum.country) >= 0 ? 'Asia' : indexof(['United Kingdom','Germany','Scandinavia','France','Italy','Netherlands','Switzerland','Other Europe'], datum.country) >= 0 ? 'Europe' : indexof(['United States of America','Canada'], datum.country) >= 0 ? 'Americas' : 'Other'
